import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_precond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  matrix.length > 0 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length > 0 ∧
  matrix.length = b.length ∧
  matrix.length ≤ 100 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length ≤ 100 ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ matrix → (∀ x, x ∈ row → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)) ∧
  (∀ x, x ∈ b → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

def is_solution (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) : Prop :=
  x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length ∧
  (∀ i, i < matrix.length →
    ( (List.range x.length).foldl (fun acc j => acc + (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0 ) % 2 = b.getD i 0)

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
namespace GF2

def dotp : List Nat → List Nat → Nat
  | [], _ => 0
  | _ :: _, [] => 0
  | a :: as, x :: xs => a * x + dotp as xs

def xorRow : List Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | [], _ => []
  | _ :: _, [] => []
  | a :: as, b :: bs => (a + b) % 2 :: xorRow as bs

def fit : Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | 0, _ => []
  | k + 1, [] => 0 :: fit k []
  | k + 1, a :: as => a :: fit k as

def reduceRow (c : Nat) (p r : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  if r.getD c 0 % 2 = 1 then xorRow r p else r

def gaussLoop : List Nat → List (Nat × List Nat) → List (List Nat) →
    List (Nat × List Nat) × List (List Nat)
  | [], piv, rows => (piv, rows)
  | c :: cs, piv, rows =>
    match rows.find? (fun r => r.getD c 0 % 2 == 1) with
    | none => gaussLoop cs piv rows
    | some p =>
        gaussLoop cs (piv.map (fun q => (q.1, reduceRow c p q.2)) ++ [(c, p)])
          (rows.map (reduceRow c p))

def buildX (n : Nat) (piv : List (Nat × List Nat)) : List Nat :=
  (List.range n).map (fun j =>
    match piv.find? (fun z => z.1 == j) with
    | none => 0
    | some z => z.2.getD n 0 % 2)

def initRows (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (n : Nat) : List (List Nat) :=
  (List.range matrix.length).map (fun i => fit n (matrix.getD i []) ++ [b.getD i 0])

def solveFrom (n : Nat) (res : List (Nat × List Nat) × List (List Nat)) : Option (List Nat) :=
  if res.2.all (fun r => r.getD n 0 % 2 == 0) then some (buildX n res.1) else none

def solveCore (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) : Option (List Nat) :=
  solveFrom (matrix.getD 0 []).length
    (gaussLoop (List.range (matrix.getD 0 []).length) [] (initRows matrix b (matrix.getD 0 []).length))

end GF2
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def solve_linear_system_gf2 (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Option (List Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  GF2.solveCore matrix b
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (result : Option (List Nat)) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some x => is_solution matrix b x
  | none => ∀ x, x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length → (∀ v, v ∈ x → v = 0 ∨ v = 1) → ¬ is_solution matrix b x
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
namespace GF2

theorem dotp_nil (r : List Nat) : dotp r [] = 0 := by
  cases r <;> simp [dotp]

theorem xorRow_length (a b : List Nat) : (xorRow a b).length = min a.length b.length := by
  induction a generalizing b with
  | nil => simp [xorRow]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases b with
    | nil => simp [xorRow]
    | cons y ys => simp [xorRow, ih ys]

theorem getD_app_lt : ∀ (l1 l2 : List Nat) (j : Nat), j < l1.length →
    (l1 ++ l2).getD j 0 = l1.getD j 0 := by
  intro l1
  induction l1 with
  | nil => intro l2 j h; simp at h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro l2 j h
    cases j with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.getD_cons_succ]
      exact ih l2 k (by simpa using Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h)

theorem getD_app_len : ∀ (l1 l2 : List Nat), (l1 ++ l2).getD l1.length 0 = l2.getD 0 0 := by
  intro l1
  induction l1 with
  | nil => intro l2; simp
  | cons a t ih => intro l2; simpa using ih l2

theorem xorRow_getD : ∀ (a b : List Nat) (j : Nat), j < a.length → j < b.length →
    (xorRow a b).getD j 0 = (a.getD j 0 + b.getD j 0) % 2 := by
  intro a
  induction a with
  | nil => intro b j h _; simp at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro b j h1 h2
    cases b with
    | nil => simp at h2
    | cons y ys =>
      cases j with
      | zero => simp [xorRow]
      | succ k =>
        simp only [xorRow, List.getD_cons_succ]
        exact ih ys k (by simpa using Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h1)
          (by simpa using Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h2)

theorem dotp_xor : ∀ (a b x : List Nat), a.length = b.length →
    dotp (xorRow a b) x % 2 = (dotp a x + dotp b x) % 2 := by
  intro a
  induction a with
  | nil =>
    intro b x h
    have : b = [] := by cases b with | nil => rfl | cons _ _ => simp at h
    subst this; simp [xorRow, dotp]
  | cons u us ih =>
    intro b x h
    cases b with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons v vs =>
      cases x with
      | nil => simp [xorRow, dotp]
      | cons w ws =>
        have hlen : us.length = vs.length := by simpa using h
        have ihw := ih vs ws hlen
        have h1 : ((u + v) % 2 * w) % 2 = (u * w + v * w) % 2 := by
          rw [Nat.mul_mod, show ((u + v) % 2) % 2 = (u + v) % 2 from by omega,
            ← Nat.mul_mod, add_mul]
        simp only [xorRow, dotp]
        rw [Nat.add_mod ((u + v) % 2 * w), h1, ihw, ← Nat.add_mod]
        omega

theorem fit_length : ∀ (k : Nat) (r : List Nat), (fit k r).length = k := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro r; simp [fit]
  | succ n ih => intro r; cases r <;> simp [fit, ih]

theorem dotp_fit : ∀ (k : Nat) (r x : List Nat), x.length ≤ k → dotp (fit k r) x = dotp r x := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro r x h
    have : x = [] := by cases x with | nil => rfl | cons _ _ => simp at h
    subst this; simp [fit, dotp_nil]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro r x h
    cases x with
    | nil => simp [dotp_nil]
    | cons w ws =>
      have hw : ws.length ≤ n := by simpa using Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h
      cases r with
      | nil => simp [fit, dotp, ih [] ws hw]
      | cons a as => simp [fit, dotp, ih as ws hw]

theorem dotp_append_single : ∀ (a x : List Nat) (u v : Nat), a.length = x.length →
    dotp (a ++ [u]) (x ++ [v]) = dotp a x + u * v := by
  intro a
  induction a with
  | nil =>
    intro x u v h
    have : x = [] := by cases x with | nil => rfl | cons _ _ => simp at h
    subst this; simp [dotp]
  | cons p ps ih =>
    intro x u v h
    cases x with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons w ws =>
      have hl : ps.length = ws.length := by simpa using h
      simp only [List.cons_append, dotp, ih ws u v hl]
      omega

theorem dotp_eq_sum : ∀ (x r : List Nat),
    dotp r x = ((List.range x.length).map (fun j => r.getD j 0 * x.getD j 0)).sum := by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro r; simp [dotp_nil]
  | cons v xs ih =>
    intro r
    cases r with
    | nil =>
      simp only [dotp]
      symm
      apply List.sum_eq_zero
      intro y hy
      simp at hy
      obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := hy
      simp
    | cons a as =>
      simp only [dotp, List.length_cons, List.range_succ_eq_map, List.map_cons, List.map_map,
        List.sum_cons]
      rw [ih as]
      congr 1

theorem foldl_add_sum (f : Nat → Nat) : ∀ (l : List Nat) (s : Nat),
    l.foldl (fun acc j => acc + f j) s = s + (l.map f).sum := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro s; simp
  | cons a t ih => intro s; simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ih (s + f a)]; omega

theorem sum_zero_mod (f : Nat → Nat) : ∀ (n : Nat), (∀ j, j < n → f j % 2 = 0) →
    ((List.range n).map f).sum % 2 = 0 := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro _; simp
  | succ k ih =>
    intro h
    rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.sum_append]
    have h1 := ih (fun j hj => h j (by omega))
    have h2 := h k (by omega)
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil]
    omega

theorem sum_isolate (f : Nat → Nat) : ∀ (n d : Nat), d < n → (∀ j, j < n → j ≠ d → f j % 2 = 0) →
    ((List.range n).map f).sum % 2 = f d % 2 := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro d h _; omega
  | succ k ih =>
    intro d hd h
    rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.sum_append]
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil]
    by_cases hk : d = k
    · subst hk
      have h1 := sum_zero_mod f d (fun j hj => h j (by omega) (by omega))
      omega
    · have hdk : d < k := by omega
      have h1 := ih d hdk (fun j hj hne => h j (by omega) hne)
      have h2 := h k (by omega) (by omega)
      omega

theorem dotp_split (r x : List Nat) (n : Nat) (hx : x.length = n) :
    dotp r (x ++ [1]) = ((List.range n).map (fun j => r.getD j 0 * x.getD j 0)).sum
      + r.getD n 0 := by
  rw [dotp_eq_sum]
  have hl : (x ++ [1]).length = n + 1 := by simp [hx]
  rw [hl, List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.sum_append]
  have h1 : (List.range n).map (fun j => r.getD j 0 * (x ++ [1]).getD j 0)
      = (List.range n).map (fun j => r.getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) := by
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro j hj
    rw [List.mem_range] at hj
    rw [getD_app_lt x [1] j (by omega)]
  rw [h1]
  have h2 : (x ++ [1]).getD n 0 = 1 := by
    rw [← hx, getD_app_len]; simp
  simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, h2, Nat.mul_one,
    Nat.add_zero]

theorem map_range_getD (f : Nat → Nat) (n j : Nat) (h : j < n) :
    ((List.range n).map f).getD j 0 = f j := by
  have hlen : ((List.range n).map f).length = n := by simp
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by omega)]
  simp

theorem buildX_length (n : Nat) (piv : List (Nat × List Nat)) : (buildX n piv).length = n := by
  simp [buildX]

theorem find_key : ∀ (piv : List (Nat × List Nat)), (piv.map Prod.fst).Nodup →
    ∀ q ∈ piv, piv.find? (fun z => z.1 == q.1) = some q := by
  intro piv
  induction piv with
  | nil => intro _ q hq; simp at hq
  | cons z t ih =>
    intro hnd q hq
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.nodup_cons] at hnd
    by_cases hzq : z.1 = q.1
    · have : q = z := by
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hq with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd (by rw [hzq]; exact List.mem_map_of_mem h) hnd.1
      subst this
      simp
    · have hqt : q ∈ t := by
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hq with h | h
        · exact absurd (by rw [h]) hzq
        · exact h
      have hb : (z.1 == q.1) = false := by simpa using hzq
      simp only [List.find?_cons, hb]
      exact ih hnd.2 q hqt

theorem reduceRow_length (c : Nat) (p r : List Nat) (h : r.length = p.length) :
    (reduceRow c p r).length = r.length := by
  unfold reduceRow
  split
  · rw [xorRow_length]; omega
  · rfl

theorem reduceRow_getD_mod (c j : Nat) (p r : List Nat) (hj : j < r.length) (hjp : j < p.length) :
    (reduceRow c p r).getD j 0
      = (r.getD j 0 + (if r.getD c 0 % 2 = 1 then p.getD j 0 else 0)) % 2 ∨
    (reduceRow c p r).getD j 0 = r.getD j 0 ∧ r.getD c 0 % 2 ≠ 1 := by
  unfold reduceRow
  by_cases h : r.getD c 0 % 2 = 1
  · left; rw [if_pos h, xorRow_getD r p j hj hjp, if_pos h]
  · right; rw [if_neg h]; exact ⟨rfl, h⟩

theorem reduceRow_getD_zero (c j : Nat) (p r : List Nat) (hj : j < r.length) (hjp : j < p.length)
    (hr : r.getD j 0 % 2 = 0) (hp : p.getD j 0 % 2 = 0) :
    (reduceRow c p r).getD j 0 % 2 = 0 := by
  rcases reduceRow_getD_mod c j p r hj hjp with h | ⟨h, _⟩ <;> rw [h]
  · split <;> omega
  · omega

theorem reduceRow_getD_one (c j : Nat) (p r : List Nat) (hj : j < r.length) (hjp : j < p.length)
    (hr : r.getD j 0 % 2 = 1) (hp : p.getD j 0 % 2 = 0) :
    (reduceRow c p r).getD j 0 % 2 = 1 := by
  rcases reduceRow_getD_mod c j p r hj hjp with h | ⟨h, _⟩ <;> rw [h]
  · split <;> omega
  · omega

theorem reduceRow_getD_at (c : Nat) (p r : List Nat) (hj : c < r.length) (hjp : c < p.length)
    (hp : p.getD c 0 % 2 = 1) : (reduceRow c p r).getD c 0 % 2 = 0 := by
  rcases reduceRow_getD_mod c c p r hj hjp with h | ⟨h, h2⟩ <;> rw [h]
  · split <;> omega
  · omega

theorem reduceRow_sat_iff (c : Nat) (p r xa : List Nat) (h : r.length = p.length)
    (hp : dotp p xa % 2 = 0) :
    (dotp (reduceRow c p r) xa % 2 = 0 ↔ dotp r xa % 2 = 0) := by
  unfold reduceRow
  split
  · rw [dotp_xor r p xa h]; omega
  · rfl

theorem reduce_sat_rows (c : Nat) (p : List Nat) (L : List (List Nat)) (xa : List Nat)
    (hlen : ∀ r ∈ L, r.length = p.length) (hp : dotp p xa % 2 = 0) :
    ((∀ r ∈ L.map (reduceRow c p), dotp r xa % 2 = 0) ↔ (∀ r ∈ L, dotp r xa % 2 = 0)) := by
  constructor
  · intro h r hr
    exact (reduceRow_sat_iff c p r xa (hlen r hr) hp).1 (h _ (List.mem_map.2 ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩))
  · intro h r' hr'
    obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hr'
    exact (reduceRow_sat_iff c p r xa (hlen r hr) hp).2 (h r hr)

theorem reduce_sat_piv (c : Nat) (p : List Nat) (L : List (Nat × List Nat)) (xa : List Nat)
    (hlen : ∀ q ∈ L, q.2.length = p.length) (hp : dotp p xa % 2 = 0) :
    ((∀ q ∈ L.map (fun q => (q.1, reduceRow c p q.2)), dotp q.2 xa % 2 = 0)
      ↔ (∀ q ∈ L, dotp q.2 xa % 2 = 0)) := by
  constructor
  · intro h q hq
    exact (reduceRow_sat_iff c p q.2 xa (hlen q hq) hp).1 (h _ (List.mem_map.2 ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩))
  · intro h q' hq'
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hq'
    exact (reduceRow_sat_iff c p q.2 xa (hlen q hq) hp).2 (h q hq)

theorem gauss_inv (n : Nat) : ∀ (cs : List Nat) (piv : List (Nat × List Nat))
    (rows : List (List Nat)),
    cs.Nodup → (∀ j ∈ cs, j < n) →
    (∀ q ∈ piv, q.2.length = n + 1) →
    (∀ r ∈ rows, r.length = n + 1) →
    (∀ q ∈ piv, q.1 < n) →
    (∀ q ∈ piv, q.1 ∉ cs) →
    ((piv.map Prod.fst).Nodup) →
    (∀ q ∈ piv, q.2.getD q.1 0 % 2 = 1) →
    (∀ q ∈ piv, ∀ q' ∈ piv, q'.1 ≠ q.1 → q.2.getD q'.1 0 % 2 = 0) →
    (∀ r ∈ rows, ∀ j, j < n → j ∉ cs → r.getD j 0 % 2 = 0) →
    ((∀ q ∈ (gaussLoop cs piv rows).1, q.2.length = n + 1) ∧
     (∀ q ∈ (gaussLoop cs piv rows).1, q.1 < n) ∧
     (∀ q ∈ (gaussLoop cs piv rows).1, q.2.getD q.1 0 % 2 = 1) ∧
     ((((gaussLoop cs piv rows).1).map Prod.fst).Nodup) ∧
     (∀ q ∈ (gaussLoop cs piv rows).1, ∀ q' ∈ (gaussLoop cs piv rows).1,
        q'.1 ≠ q.1 → q.2.getD q'.1 0 % 2 = 0) ∧
     (∀ r ∈ (gaussLoop cs piv rows).2, ∀ j, j < n → r.getD j 0 % 2 = 0) ∧
     (∀ xa, ((∀ q ∈ (gaussLoop cs piv rows).1, dotp q.2 xa % 2 = 0) ∧
             (∀ r ∈ (gaussLoop cs piv rows).2, dotp r xa % 2 = 0)) ↔
            ((∀ q ∈ piv, dotp q.2 xa % 2 = 0) ∧ (∀ r ∈ rows, dotp r xa % 2 = 0)))) := by
  intro cs
  induction cs with
  | nil =>
    intro piv rows _ _ h1 _ h3 _ h5 h6 h7 h8
    refine ⟨h1, h3, h6, h5, h7, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro r hr j hj; exact h8 r hr j hj (by simp)
    · intro xa; simp [gaussLoop]
  | cons c cs ih =>
    intro piv rows hnd hcsn hplen hrlen hpc hpnc hpnd hp1 hp2 hC
    have hcn : c < n := hcsn c (by simp)
    obtain ⟨hcnotin, hndt⟩ := List.nodup_cons.1 hnd
    cases hf : rows.find? (fun r => r.getD c 0 % 2 == 1) with
    | none =>
      have hzero : ∀ r ∈ rows, r.getD c 0 % 2 = 0 := by
        intro r hr
        have h0 := List.find?_eq_none.1 hf r hr
        simp only [beq_iff_eq] at h0
        omega
      have hstep : gaussLoop (c :: cs) piv rows = gaussLoop cs piv rows := by
        conv_lhs => rw [gaussLoop]
        rw [hf]
      rw [hstep]
      exact ih piv rows hndt (fun j hj => hcsn j (by simp [hj]))
        hplen hrlen hpc (fun q hq => fun hmem => hpnc q hq (by simp [hmem])) hpnd hp1 hp2
        (by
          intro r hr j hj hjcs
          by_cases hjc : j = c
          · subst hjc; exact hzero r hr
          · exact hC r hr j hj (by simp [hjc, hjcs]))
    | some p =>
      have hpmem : p ∈ rows := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hf
      have hpc1 : p.getD c 0 % 2 = 1 := by
        have := List.find?_some hf
        simpa using this
      have hplenp : p.length = n + 1 := hrlen p hpmem
      have hpzero : ∀ j, j < n → j ∉ (c :: cs) → p.getD j 0 % 2 = 0 := fun j hj hjc =>
        hC p hpmem j hj hjc
      set piv' := piv.map (fun q => (q.1, reduceRow c p q.2)) ++ [(c, p)] with hpiv'
      set rows' := rows.map (reduceRow c p) with hrows'
      have hstep : gaussLoop (c :: cs) piv rows = gaussLoop cs piv' rows' := by
        conv_lhs => rw [gaussLoop]
        rw [hf]
      -- length hypotheses
      have hplen' : ∀ q ∈ piv', q.2.length = n + 1 := by
        intro q hq
        rcases List.mem_append.1 hq with hq | hq
        · obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hq
          simpa [reduceRow_length c p z.2 (by rw [hplen z hz, hplenp])] using hplen z hz
        · simp at hq; subst hq; simpa using hplenp
      have hrlen' : ∀ r ∈ rows', r.length = n + 1 := by
        intro r hr
        obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hr
        rw [reduceRow_length c p z (by rw [hrlen z hz, hplenp])]
        exact hrlen z hz
      have hpc' : ∀ q ∈ piv', q.1 < n := by
        intro q hq
        rcases List.mem_append.1 hq with hq | hq
        · obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hq; exact hpc z hz
        · simp at hq; subst hq; exact hcn
      have hpnc' : ∀ q ∈ piv', q.1 ∉ cs := by
        intro q hq
        rcases List.mem_append.1 hq with hq | hq
        · obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hq
          intro hmem; exact hpnc z hz (by simp [hmem])
        · simp at hq; subst hq; simpa using hcnotin
      have hpnd' : ((piv'.map Prod.fst).Nodup) := by
        have hmap : piv'.map Prod.fst = piv.map Prod.fst ++ [c] := by
          simp [hpiv', List.map_append, List.map_map, Function.comp]
        rw [hmap]
        rw [List.nodup_append]
        refine ⟨hpnd, by simp, ?_⟩
        intro a ha bb hbb
        simp at hbb
        subst hbb
        obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 ha
        intro h
        exact hpnc z hz (by simp [h])
      have hp1' : ∀ q ∈ piv', q.2.getD q.1 0 % 2 = 1 := by
        intro q hq
        rcases List.mem_append.1 hq with hq | hq
        · obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hq
          have hd : z.1 < n := hpc z hz
          have hne : z.1 ≠ c := fun h => hpnc z hz (by simp [h])
          exact reduceRow_getD_one c z.1 p z.2 (by rw [hplen z hz]; omega)
            (by rw [hplenp]; omega) (hp1 z hz)
            (hpzero z.1 hd (hpnc z hz))
        · simp at hq; subst hq; simpa using hpc1
      have hp2' : ∀ q ∈ piv', ∀ q' ∈ piv', q'.1 ≠ q.1 → q.2.getD q'.1 0 % 2 = 0 := by
